RESEARCH PILOT · 16 SEPTEMBER 2026

Modules and backbones in Life Finds a Way

The supplied model has measurable internal structure inside its large SCCs. The present evidence supports candidate modules; it does not establish persistent, causally autonomous villages.

Nine runs, 2,000 births each, rho = 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7, seeds 42 / 43 / 44. Binding range 0.003 and lifespan 100 are retained from the repository. No run was discarded.

  • Signed community quality exceeds the randomized-control mean in 8 of 9 runs.
  • Restart agreement at the final snapshot ranges from 0.31 to 1.00; temporal agreement on shared surviving nodes ranges from 0.15 to 1.00.
  • At rho=0.3 and 0.5, observed signed quality exceeds all 19 controls in every run, but final temporal agreement is only 0.15 to 0.20. At rho=0.7 the null comparisons are inconclusive (empirical upper-tail values 0.10 to 0.55).
  • At rho=0.3, the help (2,2)-core contains 86% to 92% of living nodes. At rho=0.5 and 0.7 that core is absent. At rho=0.7 there are no directed help cycles at all. An algorithm still partitions those high-harm graphs, so a partition alone is insufficient.
  • Agreement is measured by adjusted Rand index: 1 means identical assignments, about 0 means chance-level agreement. At high harm, temporal agreement conditions on only 11 to 21 surviving shared nodes; its large values should not be read as stable villages. Stable group counts do not ensure stable membership.

What the methods measure

Signed directed Leiden searches for excess internal help and external harm. Help-only Leiden examines support grouping. Directed Infomap examines random-walk flow on help edges. Neither definition is synonymous with the actual threshold dynamics.

The help (2,2)-core recursively retains nodes with two distinct supporting predecessors and successors. Cycle backbones retain help links on directed cycles. Support-dependence scores identify recipients reliant on particular sources. These are complementary structural diagnostics, not proofs of survival.

Inspect each run

Both panels use the same signed Leiden partition. Columns sum to one when incoming weight is nonzero. A diagonal concentration means a group receives that sign mostly from itself; off-diagonal entries locate intergroup dependence. Raw edge-count block matrices are also supplied.

Detection resolution and method comparison
Module support profiles

Isolation margin fraction is a one-shot current-edge screen, without age, cascades or the historical counters. It is not observed isolated survival.

How strong is the evidence?

Nineteen randomized controls per run preserve signed directed degrees, strengths and edge-weight distributions; the optimizer is rerun on every control. They do not preserve trait compatibility, birth order or newcomer-wide multiplicity correlations. The smallest empirical tail value is 0.05. These nine exploratory comparisons are not multiplicity-corrected tests. Accepted swap counts are recorded, but mixing was not formally established. A trait-conditioned null and longer runs remain necessary.

No temporal coupling was used to manufacture stable labels. Gamma 0.5, 1 and 2 are all reported. Structural organization may be stronger than the reproducibility of any particular partition. Role structure and core-periphery organization are alternatives worth testing with a degree-corrected block model.

From structure to upward and downward causation

  1. Track candidate module membership, splits and merges across future snapshots and independent runs.
  2. Freeze labels before intervention. Compare internal help removal, equal-mass boundary help removal, matched random help removal and intact controls.
  3. Use signed degree-preserving rewiring to change arrangement while holding immediate exposures fixed. Measure survival, secondary losses, recovery and spillover; keep focal traits unchanged.
  4. Use matched exogenous event streams, not just identical RNG seeds, for paired continuations after populations diverge.
  5. Only then test whether collective arrangement affects individual fate through ordinary lower-level interactions.

No intervention outcomes are reported here. Static dependency and isolation scores are screens for choosing later interventions. Adding a survival bonus to members of a detected group would introduce the desired downward mechanism by construction.

A possible module layer

With node-to-module membership matrix M, define separate help and harm block matrices W = MT A M. The files include both. This produces an observed upper-scale network, but not autonomous upper-scale agents. Equal block totals can hide different distributions of support across members and therefore different threshold outcomes. A useful macrostate may need age and margin distributions.

Reproduce

The downloadable package contains the instrumented original simulator, analysis modules, notebook, full snapshots, memberships, nulls, source patch and methods. From the package root:

python -m pip install -r analysis/requirements.txt
python -m analysis.run_pilot
python -m analysis.make_report

Regression tests verified identical original and instrumented graph trajectories, graph attributes, dynamic statistics and NumPy RNG states at two harm settings. Additional tests cover sign separation, planted signed groups, directed cores and randomization invariants.
